name: Zargh's Meats
summary: At the Crossroads, Zargh prepares fresh meat for Gryshka in Orgrimmar. The parcel gives young Horde travelers a reason to learn the wind rider route.

sections.title: A Courier's Cargo
sections.body: Zargh, an orc butcher and hunter at the Crossroads in the Barrens, prepares fresh cuts for Gryshka, the innkeeper in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. The heat across the savannas can spoil fresh game quickly, so the parcel goes with couriers bound for the Crossroads roost. Wind Rider Master Devrak arranges a wyvern flight to Orgrimmar's Skytower, sparing travelers the long overland journey through Durotar.

sections.title: A Way to the Heart
sections.body: Zargh's delivery carries a personal sentiment along with its provisions. When Gryshka receives the meat, she recognizes Zargh's knack for winning a lady's favor with quality game. She is eager to prepare the cuts for the inn's patrons and guests. For newly arrived orc and troll travelers, the delivery offers an introduction to long-distance flight between Kalimdor's Horde settlements.

aliases: where does the meat come from
faq.answer: Zargh, an orc butcher and hunter at the Crossroads in the Barrens, prepares and packs the meat.

faq.q: Who is the recipient of the meats?
aliases: where do i deliver zarghs meats
faq.answer: Gryshka, the innkeeper in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength, receives the cuts.

faq.q: Why must the meat be taken by wind rider?
faq.answer: Fresh meat spoils quickly in the heat of the Barrens and Durotar. Zargh sends couriers to Devrak at the Crossroads roost, where a wyvern can carry the parcel to Orgrimmar before it spoils.

faq.q: Why can only certain races deliver this package?
aliases: why cant tauren get this quest
faq.answer: Orc and troll travelers carry Zargh's parcel to Orgrimmar. Tauren adventurers carry animal hides to Thunder Bluff, while Forsaken couriers take supplies back to the Sepulcher.

angles.text: As an orc, carrying Zargh's cuts to Gryshka introduces you to the Valley of Strength, the heart of your capital, and to the need for aerial travel by wyvern.
Gryshka values these fresh cuts. They show the orcish preference for rare meat, lightly cooked and taken straight from the wild beasts of the Barrens.
